title: Location Density Report
scenario: Identify all locations (lat, lon) that have more than 2 policyholders. Return the result table containing 'lat', 'lon', and 'count' of policyholders.
tableSchema: insurance (pid INT, tiv_2015 DECIMAL, tiv_2016 DECIMAL, lat DECIMAL, lon DECIMAL)
hint: Group by lat and lon, then use HAVING to filter groups with count > 2.
correctQuery: SELECT lat, lon, COUNT(pid) AS count FROM insurance GROUP BY lat, lon HAVING COUNT(pid) > 2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE insurance (pid INT, tiv_2015 DECIMAL, tiv_2016 DECIMAL, lat DECIMAL, lon DECIMAL); INSERT INTO insurance VALUES (1, 10, 5, 10, 10), (2, 20, 20, 10, 10), (3, 30, 30, 10, 10), (4, 40, 40, 50, 50);
